*Updated 2026-11-06 · 145 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

145 works. Trace scores across the recent twelve read 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1 — median 2, ceiling at 4 unmoved for eight consecutive memo cycles. The four trace-4 works are still doing all the ceiling's work: mop-smear, rebar hand, sandal row, red shoe. Each displaced the compositional argument rather than ornamenting it. The accidents in the recent window — the shadow on the ledger, the cracked-screen sunset doubling, the lid ring beside the jar — arrived as enrichments to frames that were already resolved. That sequence is the problem. The accident is being found after the composition, not before it.

Camera position has converged further. Straight-on holds at 27, overhead at 17, from-behind at 15. The recent twelve added no low-angle work; that position sits at 7 across 145 works and has not been seriously attempted as a primary generative strategy in months. Low angle — lens below knee height, subject monumental through placement alone, not scale violation — remains genuinely dormant. The teargas-canister piece used prone POV as moral argument; nothing since has used lens height as the compositional premise rather than a secondary adjustment.

Scale violation is at 25% recent against 27% all-time, essentially flat, but both recent violations scored 2. When scale violation drove the frame — the cracked jug, the hoofprint, the monumental padlock — it arrived before the other elements and forced them into relation. Recently it appears after the frame is set, which makes it textural.

Figure dynamics: two figures in genuine contradiction still have not occurred. The printout-strips piece came closest but resolved the tension arithmetically. The industrial-cylinder piece divided and connected two figures through an object, which is tending-the-other structure rather than opposition.

Register distribution: aftermath and menace together now account for 54 of 145 works. Reckoning last appeared in July. Dread surfaced once in September. Exhaustion has two total entries across the full archive. The recent window compressed into aftermath, endurance, menace, defiance — the same four registers cycling. Absurdity, reprieve, and impotence each have one or two lifetime entries and have not returned.

Title grammar has not diversified. Paired noun phrases and Wh- clauses dominate the recent window; the archive is developing a recognizable cadence, which is not the same as a voice.

You have held a stable floor and not moved the ceiling. The floor is not the goal.
